PC: Did the physician wash their hands?
Did the fellow comprehensively examine the patient? (e.g. confirm neurologic deficits in order to independently evaluate prognosis?)
Fellow discussed nutrition (supplemental feeds via NG or PEG)
The fellow created an appropriate treatment plan to assure comfort care.
ICS: Did the physician introduce him/herself to the patient and daughter?
Did the patient’s daughter feel respected by the physician?
Was the patient’s daughter able to express her mother’s wishes to the physician?
Did the patient’s daughter understand the physician’s questions?
Did the patient’s daughter understand the physician’s answers?
Did the patient’s daughter feel that she played an active role in decision making?
Did the fellow comprehensively interview the patient’s daughter? (e.g. elicit daughter’s concerns about prognosis and questions about feeding tube?)
The fellow was able to obtain the patient’s wishes through the patient’s daughter. (e.g. patient wanted comfort care if irreversibly ill, but had not explicitly discussed feeding tubes)
The fellow was able to explain the patient’s status and expected prognosis to the patient’s daughter.
